sources.snippet: basal-omni-pico is our smallest typed-decision model for Polish and English. It has 0.8B parameters, it is built on Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base (the larger basal-omni models are built on Gemma 4), it reads text only, and it was trained with our basal-omni-1.0-ultra (31B) as the teacher. It reads the same requests as the larger basal models.
